text: This report is looking to address the attraction and retention challenges with regards to compensation at the Toronto Zoo.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 14, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that the information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 14, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo, remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information about labour relations/employee negotiations.
